records.name: White Sugar
records.description: Refined sucrose used as a sweetener.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

cautions: Added sugars provide calories with little micronutrient value; limit intake.
records.servingSuggestions: Use small amounts and compare labels on packaged foods.

records.name: Jaggery
records.description: Traditional concentrated cane or palm sweetener.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Contains small amounts of minerals depending on processing.
cautions: Still a concentrated sugar source and should be used sparingly.
Nutrient composition varies by source and processing.
records.servingSuggestions: Use small amounts in traditional foods.
records.selectionTips: Choose clean, food-grade jaggery without visible contaminants.

seo.title: Jaggery nutrition, benefits and health information
seo.description: Nutrition, benefits, serving ideas, selection and storage information for Jaggery.

sources: Indian Food Composition Tables (ICMR-NIN), where applicable

records.name: Honey
records.description: Sweet substance produced by bees from floral nectar.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g edible portion; representative reference value unless stated otherwise

healthBenefits: Provides sweetness and small amounts of naturally occurring compounds.
cautions: Still a sugar-rich food; use sparingly.
Do not give honey to infants under 12 months.
records.servingSuggestions: Use small quantities in foods or drinks.
records.selectionTips: Choose food-grade honey from a reputable source.
records.storageTips: Keep tightly closed at room temperature.

seo.description: Nutrition, benefits, serving ideas, selection and storage information for Honey.

sources: Indian Food Composition Tables (ICMR-NIN), where applicable
